title: Stock Market Today Live, 13 August: Sensex, Nifty trade with negative bias amid firm crude oil prices - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Sensex Today, Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates - Find here all the live updates related to Sensex, Nifty, BSE, NSE, share prices and Indian stock markets for 13 August 2026.

Indian equity markets trade on a flat note with a negative bias on Thursday, pointing to another subdued session for investors. At 1.07 p.m., the Sensex was down 89.35 points, or 0.11 per cent, at 77,877.00, while the Nifty fell 70.20 points, or 0.29 per cent, to 24,365.75.

Most Asia-Pacific equities were trading higher in early deals, but Indian stocks remained under pressure amid firm crude oil prices.

India’s CPI inflation rose slightly to 4.45% year-on-year, compared with 4.38% in June and an estimate of 4.4%, breaching the RBI’s inflation threshold for the second month since January 2025. Elara Securities said contained super-core inflation and the recent rise in headline inflation, largely driven by food prices, may not warrant a policy rate hike at this juncture. It expects the RBI to maintain status quo through CY26E, with a possible 25-basis-point hike in Q1CY27E.

Meanwhile, MSCI India’s August rebalancing has added four stocks — Adani Energy Solutions, Laurus Labs, LensKART Solutions and Billionbrains Garage (Groww) — while removing three stocks: Astral, Balkrishna Industries and SBI Cards.

Softer-than-expected US inflation improved global risk appetite, while strong AI infrastructure earnings boosted technology stocks. However, elevated crude prices and Strait of Hormuz tensions remain key concerns. Tata Group stocks and financials are also in focus.

Follow our stock market live updates here | Q1 LIVE UPDATES | IPO NEWS TODAY | Stay tuned for more from businessline.

* Nifty 50: Trading around 24,350, down about 0.3%, with a bearish bias.

* Advance/decline ratio: 17/33, indicating broader market weakness.

* Immediate support: 24,370–24,400, where Nifty futures have support and the 21-day moving average is at 24,370.

* Key support levels: 24,400 and 24,200.

* Immediate resistance: 24,600; a decisive breakout could open the way towards 24,800.

* Downside trigger: A break below 24,370 could strengthen bearish momentum, with targets at 24,200 and 24,000.

* Bullish trigger: Holding above 24,370 could support a rebound towards 24,600.

* Nifty futures: August futures are around 24,430, with the 24,370–24,400 zone emerging as the key support band.

* Sectoral trend: Nifty Media (+1.3%) is the top gainer, while Nifty Cement (-1%) is the weakest.

* Top gainers: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles (+1.7%) and Shriram Finance (+1.5%).

* Top losers: UltraTech Cement (-2.4%) and Hindalco Industries (-2.2%).

* Trading setup: The stated strategy is to buy Nifty futures around 24,430, with a stop-loss at 24,350 and a profit-booking level of 24,600.

A revival in the global AI trade pushed South Korean stocks into a technical bull market, marking a dramatic turnaround from last month’s historic rout.
